8843uint8_t mpu6500_self_test(mpu6500_handle_t *handle, int32_t gyro_offset_raw[3], int32_t accel_offset_raw[3])
8844{
8845 uint8_t res;
8846 uint8_t prev;
8847 int32_t gyro_offset_raw_st[3];
8848 int32_t accel_offset_raw_st[3];
8849
8850 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
8851 {
8852 return 2; /* return error */
8853 }
8854 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
8855 {
8856 return 3; /* return error */
8857 }
8858
8859 res = a_mpu6500_get_st_biases(handle, gyro_offset_raw, accel_offset_raw, 0); /* get st biases */
8860 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8861 {
8862 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: get st biases failed.\n"); /* get st biases failed */
8863
8864 return 1; /* return error */
8865 }
8866 res = a_mpu6500_get_st_biases(handle, gyro_offset_raw_st, accel_offset_raw_st, 1); /* get st biases */
8867 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8868 {
8869 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: get st biases failed.\n"); /* get st biases failed */
8870
8871 return 1; /* return error */
8872 }
8873 res = a_mpu6500_accel_self_test(handle, accel_offset_raw, accel_offset_raw_st); /* accel self test */
8874 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8875 {
8876 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: accel self test failed.\n"); /* accel self test failed */
8877
8878 return 1; /* return error */
8879 }
8880 res = a_mpu6500_gyro_self_test(handle, gyro_offset_raw, gyro_offset_raw_st); /* gyro self test */
8881 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8882 {
8883 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: gyro self test failed.\n"); /* gyro self test failed */
8884
8885 return 1; /* return error */
8886 }
8887
8888 prev = 1 << 7; /* reset the device */
8889 res = a_mpu6500_write(handle, MPU6500_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, &prev, 1); /* write pwr mgmt 1 */
8890 if (res != 0) /* check the result */
8891 {
8892 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: write pwr mgmt 1 failed.\n"); /* write pwr mgmt 1 failed */
8893
8894 return 1; /* return error */
8895 }
8896 handle->delay_ms(100); /* delay 100ms */
8897 res = a_mpu6500_read(handle, MPU6500_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* read config */
8898 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8899 {
8900 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: read power management 1 failed.\n"); /* read power management 1 failed */
8901
8902 return 1; /* return error */
8903 }
8904 prev &= ~(1 << 6); /* clear config */
8905 res = a_mpu6500_write(handle, MPU6500_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* write config */
8906 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8907 {
8908 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: write power management 1 failed.\n"); /* write power management 1 failed */
8909
8910 return 1; /* return error */
8911 }
8912
8913 return 0; /* success return 0 */
8914}

8927uint8_t mpu6500_set_iic_clock(mpu6500_handle_t *handle, mpu6500_iic_clock_t clk)
8928{
8929 uint8_t res;
8930 uint8_t prev;
8931
8932 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
8933 {
8934 return 2; /* return error */
8935 }
8936 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
8937 {
8938 return 3; /* return error */
8939 }
8940
8941 res = a_mpu6500_read(handle, MPU6500_REG_I2C_MST_CTRL, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* read i2c mst ctrl */
8942 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8943 {
8944 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: read i2c mst ctrl failed.\n"); /* read i2c mst ctrl failed */
8945
8946 return 1; /* return error */
8947 }
8948 prev &= ~0xF; /* clear the buffer */
8949 prev |= clk; /* set the clock */
8950 res = a_mpu6500_write(handle, MPU6500_REG_I2C_MST_CTRL, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* write i2c mst ctrl */
8951 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8952 {
8953 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: write i2c mst ctrl failed.\n"); /* write i2c mst ctrl failed */
8954
8955 return 1; /* return error */
8956 }
8957
8958 return 0; /* success return 0 */
8959}

8975 uint8_t prev;
8976
8977 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
8978 {
8979 return 2; /* return error */
8980 }
8981 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
8982 {
8983 return 3; /* return error */
8984 }
8985
8986 res = a_mpu6500_read(handle, MPU6500_REG_I2C_MST_CTRL, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* read i2c mst ctrl */
8987 if (res != 0) /* check result */
8988 {
8989 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: read i2c mst ctrl failed.\n"); /* read i2c mst ctrl failed */
8990
8991 return 1; /* return error */
8992 }
8993 *clk = (mpu6500_iic_clock_t)(prev & 0x0F); /* get the clock */
8994
8995 return 0; /* success return 0 */
8996}

9091uint8_t mpu6500_set_iic_wait_for_external_sensor(mpu6500_handle_t *handle, mpu6500_bool_t enable)
9092{
9093 uint8_t res;
9094 uint8_t prev;
9095
9096 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
9097 {
9098 return 2; /* return error */
9099 }
9100 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
9101 {
9102 return 3; /* return error */
9103 }
9104
9105 res = a_mpu6500_read(handle, MPU6500_REG_I2C_MST_CTRL, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* read i2c mst ctrl */
9106 if (res != 0) /* check result */
9107 {
9108 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: read i2c mst ctrl failed.\n"); /* read i2c mst ctrl failed */
9109
9110 return 1; /* return error */
9111 }
9112 prev &= ~(1 << 6); /* clear the settings */
9113 prev |= enable << 6; /* set the bool */
9114 res = a_mpu6500_write(handle, MPU6500_REG_I2C_MST_CTRL, (uint8_t *)&prev, 1); /* write i2c mst ctrl */
9115 if (res != 0) /* check result */
9116 {
9117 handle->debug_print("mpu6500: write i2c mst ctrl failed.\n"); /* write i2c mst ctrl failed */
9118
9119 return 1; /* return error */
9120 }
9121
9122 return 0; /* success return 0 */
9123}

11788 }
11789 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
11790 {
11791 return 3; /* return error */
11792 }
11793
11794 return a_mpu6500_write(handle, reg, buf, len); /* write data */
11795}
11796
11810uint8_t mpu6500_get_reg(mpu6500_handle_t *handle, uint8_t reg, uint8_t *buf, uint16_t len)
11811{
11812 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
11813 {
11814 return 2; /* return error */
11815 }
11816 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
11817 {
11818 return 3; /* return error */
11819 }
11820
11821 return a_mpu6500_read(handle, reg, buf, len); /* read data */
11822}
11823
11832uint8_t mpu6500_info(mpu6500_info_t *info)
11833{
11834 if (info == NULL) /* check handle */
11835 {
11836 return 2; /* return error */
11837 }
11838
11839 memset(info, 0, sizeof(mpu6500_info_t)); /* initialize mpu6500 info structure */
11840 strncpy(info->chip_name, CHIP_NAME, 32); /* copy chip name */
11841 strncpy(info->manufacturer_name, MANUFACTURER_NAME, 32); /* copy manufacturer name */
11842 strncpy(info->interface, "IIC SPI", 8); /* copy interface name */
11843 info->supply_voltage_min_v = SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_MIN; /* set minimal supply voltage */
11844 info->supply_voltage_max_v = SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_MAX; /* set maximum supply voltage */
11845 info->max_current_ma = MAX_CURRENT; /* set maximum current */
11846 info->temperature_max = TEMPERATURE_MAX; /* set minimal temperature */
11847 info->temperature_min = TEMPERATURE_MIN; /* set maximum temperature */
11848 info->driver_version = DRIVER_VERSION; /* set driver version */
11849
11850 return 0; /* success return 0 */
11851}
